name: web-app
title: Web application
description: An HTTP service with a stable address in the namespace. Optionally available from outside the cluster through a host name.

parameters.name: image
parameters.title: Image
parameters.description: Image in the registry project of the tenant, for example shop:1.4.2.

parameters.name: replicas
parameters.title: Replicas
parameters.description: Number of pods. Two or more pods keep the service available during updates.

parameters.name: port
parameters.title: Port
parameters.description: The port where the program listens. The PORT variable also has this value.

parameters.name: health_path
parameters.title: Health check path
parameters.description: The path that answers 2xx or 3xx when the program is ready.

parameters.name: host
parameters.title: Public host name
parameters.description: Optional. If you set it, the service is available from outside the cluster at this name.

parameters.name: env
parameters.title: Environment variables
parameters.description: One NAME=value on each line. Do not put secrets here: Git keeps all values.
